title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is steady. Upslope has run since about 08:00 at a light 1 mph. Trades are holding the shear line crossing Kula Highway between the middle Lower Kula Road junction and Waiakoa, with no trade air on the lower west slope. The line is at Naalae Road or further south, where Kula is usually not flyable.
